content.name: Rohan Deshpande
content.title: Head of Pharmacy Services
content.summary: Hospital pharmacist with 15 years in clinical and operational pharmacy, now heading pharmacy services for a 550-bed tertiary care hospital with 68 staff. I led the department through two NABH reaccreditations and cut drug inventory holding by ₹1.8 crore without stock-outs of critical medicines.

experience.title: Clinical Pharmacist
bullets: Reviewed prescriptions for 60–70 inpatients a day on medicine and nephrology wards and recommended dose changes in renal impairment.
Set up the hospital's first adverse drug reaction reporting desk, raising ADR reports to the PvPI centre from 12 to 140 a year.
Counselled discharged patients on anticoagulants and insulin in English, Hindi and Marathi.

experience.title: Senior Clinical Pharmacist
bullets: Led a team of 6 clinical pharmacists covering ICUs, oncology and paediatrics.
Developed the hospital's antimicrobial policy with the infection control committee, reducing carbapenem use by 27% in two years.
Trained 30 Pharm.D interns a year on clinical rotations as their site preceptor.

experience.title: Pharmacy Manager
bullets: Managed inpatient, outpatient and OT pharmacies with 42 staff and an annual drug spend of ₹85 crore.
Introduced barcode-based dispensing and automated reorder levels in the HIS, cutting dispensing errors by 46%.
Negotiated rate contracts with 30+ suppliers, saving ₹3.2 crore in the first year.
Kept 24x7 supply running through the COVID-19 surges, including remdesivir and tocilizumab allocation as per state guidelines.

experience.title: Head of Pharmacy Services
bullets: Head a department of 68 pharmacists and pharmacy assistants across six pharmacies in a 550-bed hospital.
Reduced inventory holding by ₹1.8 crore through ABC-VED analysis and consignment stock for high-cost implants and oncology drugs.
Led pharmacy chapters for two NABH reaccreditations with no major non-conformities.
Chair the pharmacy and therapeutics committee, maintaining a 1,100-item formulary.

education.school: Bombay College of Pharmacy (University of Mumbai)

achievements.title: Registered Pharmacist
achievements.detail: Registered with the Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council since 2009.

achievements.title: Conference speaker
achievements.detail: Presented the hospital's antimicrobial stewardship results at a national hospital pharmacy conference, 2017.
